gloss: a world apart; incomparably different; on a different level

definitions.gloss: a world apart; incomparably different; on a different level
definitions.explanation: so different in quality or degree that comparison is hardly possible; leagues apart

examples.japanese: ⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{段違|だんちが}いだ。
examples.english: The flavor is on a completely different level.
There's a world of difference between pros and amateurs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦モデル→モデル：05112_moderu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{性能|せいのう}→性能：04340_seinou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{段違|だんちが}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: The new model is incomparably better in performance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{段違|だんちが}いだ。
examples.english: The team's ability is on a completely different level compared to last year.

notes:
Literally means being on different steps or levels (⟦{段|だん}→段：03424_dan⟧ = step/level, ⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧ = difference). Describes a gap in quality or ability that is not just noticeable but dramatic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {段違|だんちが}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧: an overwhelming difference
- {段違|だんちが}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧: incomparably better
- {段違|だんちが}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧: ability on a different level
- {段違|だんちが}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{速|はや}い→速い：00514_hayai⟧: incomparably faster

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{桁違|けたちが}い→桁違い：15744_ketachigai⟧: on a different order of magnitude; emphasizes numerical scale, while {段違|だんちが}い emphasizes quality or skill
- ⟦{格段|かくだん}→格段：13112_kakudan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: remarkably, significantly; more formal and used adverbially
- ⟦{雲泥|うんでい}の{差|さ}→雲泥の差：19998_undeinosa⟧: a world of difference (literally "the difference between clouds and mud"); more literary

USAGE:
Also used in gymnastics: {段違|だんちが}い{平行棒|へいこうぼう} means uneven parallel bars.
